set up claude's settings, one of the commands below: those a project shares
through git, or your own, which claude reads in every project. Each adds what
the settings lack, and keeps the values they have.

Usage:
  cld setup config [command]

Available Commands:
  project     set claude up in the project in the current directory
  user        set claude up in your own settings, for every project

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for config

Use "cld setup config [command] --help" for more information about a command.
